detail.longDescription: Wonderful new work from Tom Clandinin's lab on how an animal's internal neural activity decides whether to react to external stimuli or to ignore them: "Unique neural activity states predict action selection in response to visual threat" https://www. sciencedirect.com/science/arti cle/pii/S0960982226010080 Dovetails nicely with what people have found in other animals. # neuroscience # behavior # biology # research # science
